function ensurePixelAsset(key){
 const uri=ART_DATA.urls[key]; if(!uri)return Promise.resolve(null);
 let im=PIXEL_ART[key]; if(!im){im=new Image();PIXEL_ART[key]=im}
 if(im.complete&&im.naturalWidth)return Promise.resolve(im);
 if(ASSET_PROMISES.has('pixel:'+key))return ASSET_PROMISES.get('pixel:'+key);
 const p=new Promise(resolve=>{im.onload=()=>{worldCacheKey='';resolve(im)};im.onerror=()=>resolve(null);im.src=uri});
 ASSET_PROMISES.set('pixel:'+key,p);return p;
}

function preloadUrl(uri){if(!uri)return Promise.resolve(null);if(ASSET_PROMISES.has('url:'+uri))return ASSET_PROMISES.get('url:'+uri);const im=new Image();const p=new Promise(resolve=>{im.onload=()=>resolve(im);im.onerror=()=>resolve(null);im.src=uri});ASSET_PROMISES.set('url:'+uri,p);return p}

function preloadAreaAssets(area){
 if(PREFETCHED_AREAS.has(area))return Promise.resolve();
 PREFETCHED_AREAS.add(area);
 const jobs=(AREA_ASSET_KEYS[area]||[]).map(ensurePixelAsset);
 if(area==='town')jobs.push(preloadUrl(ART_DATA.urls.heroPortrait),preloadUrl(ART_DATA.urls.avatar_novice));
 for(const id of AREA_PORTRAITS[area]||[])jobs.push(preloadUrl(resolvedPortraitUri(id)));
 return Promise.all(jobs).then(()=>undefined);
}
function adjacentAreas(area){const out=new Set();for(const x of (GATES[area]||[]))if(x.to)out.add(x.to);if(typeof DOORS!=='undefined')for(const x of (DOORS[area]||[]))if(x.to)out.add(x.to);return [...out]}
function scheduleAdjacentPrefetch(area){const run=()=>{const list=adjacentAreas(area).filter(x=>!PREFETCHED_AREAS.has(x));let i=0;const next=()=>{if(i>=list.length)return;preloadAreaAssets(list[i++]).finally(()=>setTimeout(next,120))};next()};if('requestIdleCallback'in window)requestIdleCallback(run,{timeout:1200});else setTimeout(run,650)}

const rand=(a,b)=>a+Math.random()*(b-a),clamp=(v,a,b)=>Math.max(a,Math.min(b,v)),distance=(a,b)=>Math.hypot(a.x-b.x,a.y-b.y),round=n=>Math.round(n),C=(x,y)=>({x,y}),areaInfo=()=>AREAS[s.area],needXP=()=>Math.round(65*Math.pow(s.level,1.24)),atk=()=>s.baseAttack+s.weapon*8+(s.cls==='mage'?6:s.cls==='ranger'?8:0),def=()=>s.baseDefense+s.armor*4+(s.cls==='knight'?5:0);

function updateHeroFacing(dx,dy){if(!dx&&!dy)return;let dir=hero.facing;
 if(Math.abs(dx)>Math.abs(dy))dir=dx<0?1:2;else if(Math.abs(dy)>Math.abs(dx))dir=dy<0?3:0;
 else if(dir===1||dir===2)dir=dx<0?1:2;else dir=dy<0?3:0;setHeroFacing(dir)}
function buildAmbientNPCs(area){ambientNPCs=[];const count=AMBIENT_COUNTS[area]||0,routes=AMBIENT_ROUTES[area]||[];if(!count||!routes.length)return;
 const rng=seeded(78013+ORDER.indexOf(area)*907);for(let i=0;i<count;i++){const base=routes[i%routes.length],route=base.map(([x,y],j)=>({x:x+(rng()-.5)*22,y:y+(rng()-.5)*18}));const start=Math.floor(rng()*route.length),p=route[start];ambientNPCs.push({ambient:true,id:'ambient-'+area+'-'+i,name:AMBIENT_NAMES[i%AMBIENT_NAMES.length],actor:AMBIENT_ACTORS[(i+ORDER.indexOf(area)*3)%AMBIENT_ACTORS.length],x:p.x,y:p.y,route,target:(start+1)%route.length,speed:38+rng()*28,wait:rng()*1.8,dir:0,frame:0,step:rng()*8,chat:0,line:AMBIENT_LINES[(i*3+ORDER.indexOf(area))%AMBIENT_LINES.length]})}}
function updateAmbientNPCs(dt){for(const n of ambientNPCs){n.chat=Math.max(0,n.chat-dt);n.step+=dt*5.5;if(n.wait>0){n.wait-=dt;continue}const p=n.route[n.target],dx=p.x-n.x,dy=p.y-n.y,d=Math.hypot(dx,dy);if(d<8){n.x=p.x;n.y=p.y;n.target=(n.target+1)%n.route.length;n.wait=.35+((n.target*37+n.x*.01)%1.7);continue}
 const vx=dx/d,vy=dy/d;if(Math.abs(vx)>Math.abs(vy))n.dir=vx<0?1:2;else n.dir=vy<0?3:0;const nearHero=Math.hypot(n.x-hero.x,n.y-hero.y)<42;if(nearHero){n.wait=.25;continue}const move=Math.min(d,n.speed*dt);n.x+=vx*move;n.y+=vy*move}}

function sideOptions(id,opts){let rec=s.side[id];const q=SIDES[id];if(!rec){opts.push({title:'接取支線：'+q.title,detail:q.desc,primary:true,action:()=>addSide(id)})}else if(rec.completed){opts.push({title:'已完成 ✓',detail:'感謝你幫助了星森的居民',disabled:true})}else if(sideReady(id)){opts.push({title:'繳交任務・領取報酬',detail:`${q.reward} 金幣、${q.xp} 經驗、${q.bonus}`,primary:true,action:()=>finishSide(id)})}else{opts.push({title:'查看採集與討伐進度',detail:q.requirements.map(([k,n])=>`${labelMetric(k)} ${sideProgress(id,k)}/${n}`).join('、'),disabled:true})}}
function shopDialogue(id){nextPortrait=id;let body='<p>「踏入野外前，記得帶好藥水。好的補給有時比鋒利的劍更可靠。」</p><div class="tag">購買後立即放進背包</div><div class="tag">無需網路・遊戲金幣</div>';
 const opts=[{title:'🧪 生命藥水 ×1',detail:'20 金幣 · 回復 80 HP',disabled:s.gold<20,action:()=>buy('potion',1,id)},{title:'🧪 生命藥水 ×5',detail:'90 金幣 · 省下 10 金幣',disabled:s.gold<90,action:()=>buy('potion',5,id)},{title:'🌟 生命與魔力全滿',detail:'30 金幣 · 原地補給',disabled:s.gold<30,action:()=>buy('rest',1,id)},{title:'💎 星塵 ×1',detail:'40 金幣 · 法師轉職試煉可用',disabled:s.gold<40,action:()=>buy('dust',1,id)},{title:'結束交易',primary:true}];modalShow('🧺 補給商店',body,opts,'✦ MERCHANT SHOP ✦')}
function buy(kind,count,id){let cost=kind==='potion'?(count===5?90:20):kind==='rest'?30:40;if(s.gold<cost)return;s.gold-=cost;if(kind==='potion')s.potions+=count;if(kind==='rest'){s.hp=s.maxHp;s.mp=s.maxMp}if(kind==='dust'){s.inventory.dust++;s.count.dust++}toast('購買成功！花費 '+cost+' 金幣');updateHud();save(true);shopDialogue(id)}
function smithDialogue(){nextPortrait='smith';const wp=(s.weapon+1)*65+25,ar=(s.armor+1)*55+25;const discount=s.oreDiscount?0.8:1;const wCost=Math.round(wp*discount),aCost=Math.round(ar*discount);let body=`<p>「這把鐵鎚打的不只是裝備，也是旅人活著回家的機會。」</p><div class="tag">武器 +${s.weapon} · 攻擊 +${s.weapon*8}</div><div class="tag">護甲 +${s.armor} · 防禦 +${s.armor*4}</div><p>強化材料：每次需 1 份精鐵礦（初次強化免費材料）；目前持有 ${s.inventory.ore} 塊。</p>`;
 let opts=[{title:'⚔️ 購買／強化武器 +'+(s.weapon+1),detail:`花費 ${wCost} 金幣，攻擊 +8`,disabled:s.gold<wCost||s.weapon>=8||(s.weapon>0&&s.inventory.ore<1),action:()=>upgrade('weapon',wCost)},{title:'🛡️ 購買／強化護甲 +'+(s.armor+1),detail:`花費 ${aCost} 金幣，防禦 +4`,disabled:s.gold<aCost||s.armor>=8||(s.armor>0&&s.inventory.ore<1),action:()=>upgrade('armor',aCost)}];sideOptions('ore',opts);opts.push({title:'離開鍛造坊',primary:true});modalShow('⚒️ 布洛的鍛造坊',body,opts,'✦ BLACKSMITH · UPGRADE ✦')}
function upgrade(kind,cost){s.gold-=cost;if(s[kind]>0)s.inventory.ore--;s[kind]++;toast((kind==='weapon'?'⚔️ 武器':'🛡️ 護甲')+' 強化成功 +'+s[kind]);log('強化'+(kind==='weapon'?'武器':'護甲')+'至 +'+s[kind]);updateHud();save(true);smithDialogue()}
function trainerDialogue(){nextPortrait='trainer';let C=CLASSES[s.cls],body='<p>「每位冒險者終會走上不同道路。選擇職業、通過專屬試煉，便能學到兩個全新的職業技能。」</p>';
 let opts=[];if(s.cls!=='novice'){body+=`<p>你已成為 <b style="color:#ffe3a7">${C.icon} ${C.name}</b>！${C.desc}</p><p>主動技能：<b>${C.q}</b>（Q）　／　<b>${C.e}</b>（E）</p>`;opts.push({title:'已完成轉職 ✓',detail:'繼續修煉與強化裝備',disabled:true})}
 else if(s.level<2){body+='<p class="red">初次轉職需要 Lv.2。擊退草原怪物取得經驗後再來找我。</p>';opts.push({title:'等級尚不足',detail:'目前 Lv.'+s.level+' / 需要 Lv.2',disabled:true})}
 else{if(s.classTrial){const t=s.classTrial,cl=CLASSES[t.id],n=metricCount(cl.metric)-t.start;body+=`<p>目前試煉：<b>${cl.icon} ${cl.name}</b><br>${cl.req}<br><span class="gold">進度 ${Math.max(0,n)}/${cl.need}</span></p>`;if(n>=cl.need)opts.push({title:'✨ 完成轉職：'+cl.name,detail:`${cl.bonus}；獲得職業雙技能`,primary:true,action:()=>promote(t.id)});else opts.push({title:'試煉尚未完成',detail:`${Math.max(0,n)} / ${cl.need}`,disabled:true});opts.push({title:'放棄並更換試煉',detail:'重選職業會重置原試煉進度',action:()=>{s.classTrial=null;trainerDialogue()}})}else for(const id of ['knight','mage','ranger']){let cl=CLASSES[id];opts.push({title:cl.icon+' '+cl.name,detail:cl.desc+'｜試煉：'+cl.req,action:()=>{s.classTrial={id,start:metricCount(cl.metric)};toast('已接取'+cl.name+'轉職試煉');save(true);trainerDialogue()}})}}
 opts.push({title:'改天再來',primary:true});modalShow('🧝 轉職導師・黎恩',body,opts,'✦ CLASS ADVANCEMENT ✦')}
function promote(id){if(s.cls!=='novice'||!s.classTrial)return;s.cls=id;if(id==='knight'){s.maxHp+=55;s.hp+=55}else if(id==='mage'){s.maxMp+=70;s.mp+=70}else if(id==='ranger'){}s.classTrial=null;s.hp=s.maxHp;s.mp=s.maxMp;emit(hero.x,hero.y,'#ffe5ac',38,225);log('轉職為 '+CLASSES[id].name+'，解鎖 '+CLASSES[id].q+' 與 '+CLASSES[id].e);toast('✨ 轉職成功：'+CLASSES[id].name+'！');updateHud();save(true);modalShow('轉職成功！',`<div class="introart">${CLASSES[id].icon} ✨ ✦</div><p>你已成為 <b>${CLASSES[id].name}</b>。現在 Q 是「${CLASSES[id].q}」，E 是「${CLASSES[id].e}」。${CLASSES[id].bonus}。</p>`,[{title:'開始新的職業冒險',primary:true}])}
function bountyBoard(){let body='<p>懸賞可重複接取；每次接取後開始計算擊敗數量。最多可同時領取 3 件，並可於任一安全區佈告欄領賞。</p><div class="tag">已完成 '+s.bountyDone+' 張懸賞</div>';let opts=[];for(const [id,q] of Object.entries(BOUNTIES)){let b=s.bounties.find(x=>x.id===id),progress=b?bountyProgress(b):0,unlock=canGo(id==='slime'||id==='wolf'?'field':id);opts.push(b?{title:(progress>=q.count?'✅ ':'⏳ ')+q.title,detail:`進度 ${Math.min(progress,q.count)}/${q.count} · 獎勵 ${q.reward} 金幣 + ${q.xp} XP`,disabled:progress<q.count,action:()=>bountyTurn(id)}:{title:'📜 '+q.title,detail:`${q.area} · 擊敗 ${q.count} 名 · ${q.reward} 金幣`,disabled:!unlock||s.bounties.length>=3,action:()=>bountyAccept(id)})}opts.push({title:'返回冒險',primary:true,full:true});modalShow('📜 冒險者公會・懸賞欄',body,opts,'✦ HUNTER BOARD ✦')}
function labelMetric(key){return({slime:'史萊姆',wolf:'野狼',forest:'迷霧敵人',cave:'洞窟敵人',ruins:'遺跡敵人',herb:'露草藥草',leaf:'螢光葉',flower:'月見花',charm:'星星吊飾',crystal:'月光水晶',ore:'精鐵礦',page:'手稿殘頁',shard:'裂隙碎片',dust:'星塵'})[key]||key}
function mainTask(){switch(s.main){
 case 0:return{chapter:'序章',name:'長夜將至',text:'尋找星燈鎮的艾洛長老，接受守護星核的使命。',where:'星燈鎮',tasks:[['與艾洛長老交談',0,1]]};
 case 1:return{chapter:'第一章',name:'平原上的異變',text:'調查史萊姆狂躁的原因，收集異常碎片後向凱恩守衛回報。',where:'露草原野 → 星燈鎮',tasks:[['擊敗露草史萊姆',s.count.slime,4],['取得裂隙碎片',s.inventory.shard,1]]};
 case 2:return{chapter:'第二章',name:'迷霧密語',text:'深入迷霧森林擊敗敵人、採集螢光葉，向綠葉營地的瑞德斥候回報。',where:'迷霧森林 → 綠葉營地',tasks:[['擊敗森林敵人',s.count.forest,4],['採集螢光葉',s.inventory.leaf,2]]};
 case 3:return{chapter:'第三章',name:'月泉的預言',text:s.prophecy?'依照預言進入洞窟尋找水晶，回到月泉預言者身邊。':'前往月泉驛站，聆聽預言者講述古老封印。',where:s.prophecy?'月影洞窟 → 月泉驛站':'月泉驛站',tasks:s.prophecy?[['擊敗洞窟敵人',s.count.cave,4],['採集月光水晶',s.inventory.crystal,2]]:[['聆聽月泉預言',0,1]]};
 case 4:return{chapter:'第四章',name:'遺跡中的最後星光',text:'前往星核遺跡，啟動三座石碑，解除墮星之王的防護後擊敗牠。',where:'星核遺跡',tasks:[['啟動封印石碑',s.altar,3],['擊敗墮星之王',s.bossDead?1:0,1]]};
 case 5:return{chapter:'終章',name:'星核之誓',text:'攜帶恢復的星核返回星燈鎮，向艾洛長老報告。',where:'星燈鎮',tasks:[['回報長老',0,1]]};
 default:return{chapter:'傳說完成',name:'星森的新守護者',text:'主線已完成。你仍能轉職、強化裝備、完成支線與重複接取懸賞。',where:'自由冒險',tasks:[['星核之誓',1,1]]}
}}
function renderSide(){const body=$('sideBody');if(!body)return;const q=mainTask();let html='';
 if(currentTab==='quest'){
 html+=`<div class="section-title">MAIN STORY · ${q.chapter}</div><div class="q-title">✦ ${q.name}</div><p class="q-text">${q.text}</p><div class="tag">📍 ${q.where}</div>`;
 for(const [title,n,goal] of q.tasks){const done=n>=goal;html+=`<div class="task ${done?'done':''}">${done?'✓':'◻'} ${title}<span style="float:right">${Math.min(n,goal)}/${goal}</span><div class="progress"><i style="width:${100*Math.min(n/goal,1)}%"></i></div></div>`}
 if(s.classTrial&&s.cls==='novice'){let c=CLASSES[s.classTrial.id],n=Math.max(0,metricCount(c.metric)-s.classTrial.start);html+=`<div class="subhead"><b>✨ 轉職試煉 · ${c.name}</b></div><div class="task">${c.req}　${n}/${c.need}<div class="progress"><i style="width:${Math.min(100,100*n/c.need)}%"></i></div></div>`}
 const active=Object.entries(s.side).filter(([,v])=>!v.completed);html+=`<div class="subhead"><b>🌼 支線任務（${active.length} 進行中）</b><small>${Object.values(s.side).filter(x=>x.completed).length} 已完成</small></div>`;
 if(!active.length)html+='<p class="muted">與不同安全區的居民交談，即可開啟支線故事。</p>';
 for(const [id] of active){const item=SIDES[id];html+=`<div class="task">${sideReady(id)?'✅':'◻'} <b>${item.title}</b><br><em>${item.requirements.map(([k,n])=>`${labelMetric(k)} ${Math.min(sideProgress(id,k),n)}/${n}`).join('、')}</em></div>`}
 html+=`<div class="subhead"><b>⚔️ 懸賞（${s.bounties.length}/3）</b><small>已交付 ${s.bountyDone} 件</small></div>`;
 if(!s.bounties.length)html+='<p class="muted">前往安全區公會告示欄接取討伐懸賞，可反覆領取報酬。</p>';
 for(const b of s.bounties){let q=BOUNTIES[b.id],n=bountyProgress(b);html+=`<div class="task ${n>=q.count?'done':''}">${q.title}<br><em>${Math.min(n,q.count)}/${q.count} · ${n>=q.count?'回佈告欄領賞':'擊敗怪物累積進度'}</em></div>`}
 html+='<div class="hint">操作提示：靠近人物、寶物或傳送門按 <b>F</b>；按 <b>J</b> 普攻、<b>Q/E</b> 施放職業技能，<b>H</b> 使用藥水。按 <b>L</b> 開啟任務日誌。</div>';
 }else if(currentTab==='hero'){
 const c=CLASSES[s.cls];html+=`<div class="section-title">ADVENTURER · CHARACTER</div><img class="hero-portrait" src="${heroPortrait()}" width="256" height="256" alt="玩家角色256乘256肖像"><div class="hero-portrait-note">✦ 星燈守護者 · 人物檔案 ✦</div><div class="pixel-meta"><span>探索角色 32×32</span><span>轉職：${c.name}</span></div><div class="q-title">${c.icon} ${c.name}</div><p class="q-text">${c.desc}</p><div class="statsgrid"><div class="statcard"><strong>Lv. ${s.level}</strong><small>冒險等級</small></div><div class="statcard"><strong>${round(atk())}</strong><small>攻擊力</small></div><div class="statcard"><strong>${round(def())}</strong><small>防禦力</small></div><div class="statcard"><strong>${s.bountyDone}</strong><small>完成懸賞</small></div><div class="statcard"><strong>+${s.weapon}</strong><small>武器強化</small></div><div class="statcard"><strong>+${s.armor}</strong><small>防具強化</small></div></div>`;
 html+=`<div class="subhead"><b>✦ 當前裝備</b></div><div class="equipment-grid"><div class="eq-slot"><span>⚔</span><small>武器 +${s.weapon}</small></div><div class="eq-slot"><span>✧</span><small>披風</small></div><div class="eq-slot"><span>✥</span><small>護甲 +${s.armor}</small></div><div class="eq-slot"><span>♜</span><small>皮靴</small></div></div>`;

/* v1.1.5 | 無閃光霧面怪物及四幀技能（離線內嵌） */
const SW_SKILL_PNG={
 "cast_normal_64":"data:image/png;base64,",
 "cast_elite_128":"data:image/png;base64,",
 "fx_normal_64":"data:image/png;base64,",
 "fx_elite_96":"data:image/png;base64,"
};

/* v1.1.6: 各物種真實四影格移動，只有發生位移時才播放，保留 v1.1.5 霧面無閃光樣式 */
const SW_WALK_URI={"normal":"data:image/png;base64,","elite":"data:image/png;base64,"};
const SW_WALK_IMAGES={};for(const [k,src] of Object.entries(SW_WALK_URI)){let im=new Image();im.decoding='async';im.src=src;SW_WALK_IMAGES[k]=im}
const SW_WALK_STEP={slime:11,wolf:9,spider:6,treant:8,bat:8,golem:10,wraith:12,sentinel:8,toad:14,boar:7,mage:12,king:10,boss:10};
function swDrawMovingMonster(e,width){
 const king=e.type==='boss'; const elite=king||['toad','boar','mage','king'].includes(e.type);
 const im=SW_WALK_IMAGES[elite?'elite':'normal'];if(!im?.complete||!im.naturalWidth)return false;
 const cell=elite?64:32; const id=king?'king':e.type;
 const row=elite?(['toad','boar','mage','king'].indexOf(id)):(['slime','wolf','spider','treant','bat','golem','wraith','sentinel'].indexOf(id));
 if(row<0)return false;
 const frame=Math.floor((e.swWalk||0)/(SW_WALK_STEP[id]||8))%4;
 const y=king?e.y-88:e.y-width*.69;
 g.save();
 // Image convention: wolf and boar face left; horizontal reversal maintains actual travel direction.
 if((e.swFace||-1)>0){g.translate(Math.round(e.x),0);g.scale(-1,1);g.drawImage(im,frame*cell,row*cell,cell,cell,-width/2,Math.round(y),width,width)}
 else g.drawImage(im,frame*cell,row*cell,cell,cell,Math.round(e.x-width/2),Math.round(y),width,width);
 g.restore();return true;
}
const SW_SKILL_IMAGES={};
for(const [key,src] of Object.entries(SW_SKILL_PNG)){
  const img=new Image();img.decoding='async';img.src=src;SW_SKILL_IMAGES[key]=img;
}
const SW_SKILL_ROWS={slime:0,wolf:1,spider:2,treant:3,bat:4,golem:5,wraith:6,sentinel:7,toad:0,boar:1,mage:2,king:3,boss:3};
const SW_SKILL_BURSTS=[];
function swSkillSprite(type,group){
  const elite=['toad','boar','mage','king','boss'].includes(type);
  const key=(group==='cast'?'cast_':'fx_')+(elite?(group==='cast'?'elite_128':'elite_96'):'normal_64');
  return {im:SW_SKILL_IMAGES[key],cell:elite?(group==='cast'?128:96):64,row:SW_SKILL_ROWS[type]??0};
}
function swDrawSkillFrame(ctx,type,group,frame,x,y,w,h){
  const a=swSkillSprite(type,group);
  if(!a.im?.complete||!a.im.naturalWidth)return false;
  ctx.drawImage(a.im,Math.max(0,Math.min(3,frame))*a.cell,a.row*a.cell,a.cell,a.cell,
    Math.round(x),Math.round(y),Math.round(w),Math.round(h));
  return true;
}
function swSkillBurst(type,x,y,size=70){
  if(SW_SKILL_BURSTS.length>=32)SW_SKILL_BURSTS.shift();
  SW_SKILL_BURSTS.push({type,x,y,size,age:0,duration:type==='boss'?.66:.42});
}
function swUpdateSkillBursts(dt){
  for(let i=SW_SKILL_BURSTS.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    const b=SW_SKILL_BURSTS[i];b.age+=dt;if(b.age>=b.duration)SW_SKILL_BURSTS.splice(i,1);
  }
}
function swDrawSkillBursts(){
  for(const b of SW_SKILL_BURSTS){
    const f=Math.min(3,Math.floor(4*b.age/b.duration));
    g.save();g.globalAlpha=.68*Math.min(1,(b.duration-b.age)/Math.max(.14,b.duration*.38));
    swDrawSkillFrame(g,b.type,'fx',f,b.x-b.size/2,b.y-b.size/2,b.size,b.size);g.restore();
  }
}
function swDrawMonsterCast(e,width){
  const cast=e.swCast;if(!cast)return false;
  const progress=1-Math.max(0,cast.remaining)/cast.duration;
  const f=Math.min(3,Math.floor(progress*4));
  const boss=e.type==='boss';const size=boss?154:Math.max(72,width+12);
  return swDrawSkillFrame(g,e.type,'cast',f,e.x-size/2,e.y-(boss?size*.69:size*.69),size,size);
}
function swStartMonsterCast(e,angle,ranged,rounds){
  e.swCast={remaining:e.type==='boss'?.68:.46,duration:e.type==='boss'?.68:.46,
    angle,ranged,rounds};
  // 技能蓄力展示為專屬動作，不增加傷害或改變原有技能冷卻。
}
function swReleaseMonsterCast(e,cast){
  if(e.dead)return;
  const d=distance(e,hero),a=Math.atan2(hero.y-e.y,hero.x-e.x);
  swSkillBurst(e.type,e.x,e.y,e.type==='boss'?111:60);
  if(cast.ranged){
    if(d>=520)return;
    for(let j=0;j<cast.rounds;j++){
      const an=a+(j-(cast.rounds-1)/2)*(e.type==='boss'?.20:0);
      projs.push({x:e.x,y:e.y,vx:Math.cos(an)*(e.type==='boss'?340:285),
        vy:Math.sin(an)*(e.type==='boss'?340:285),life:2.2,r:e.type==='boss'?12:8,
        dmg:e.attack,color:e.type==='boss'?'#f9a6d2':'#b58fef',friendly:false,swSkill:e.type});
    }
  }else if(d<e.r+hero.r+35){
    swSkillBurst(e.type,hero.x,hero.y,e.type==='boss'?95:62);
    receiveDamage(e.attack);
  }
}
function swPaintSkillCodex(){
  const el=document.getElementById('sw-monster-codex');if(!el||!el.open)return;
  const f=Math.floor(performance.now()/185)%4;
  for(const canvas of el.querySelectorAll('canvas[data-sw-cast]')){
    const type=canvas.dataset.swCast;
    const ctx=canvas.getContext('2d');ctx.clearRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled=false;
    swDrawSkillFrame(ctx,type,'cast',f,0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);
  }
}

function monsterAI(e,dt){
 if(e.dead)return;
 e.phase+=dt;e.hit=Math.max(0,e.hit-dt);e.attackAt-=dt;
 e.stun=Math.max(0,e.stun-dt);e.slow=Math.max(0,e.slow-dt);
 if(e.stun>0)return;
 if(e.swCast){
   e.swCast.remaining-=dt;
   if(e.swCast.remaining<=0){const cast=e.swCast;e.swCast=null;swReleaseMonsterCast(e,cast)}
   return;
 }
 const d=distance(e,hero),a=Math.atan2(hero.y-e.y,hero.x-e.x);
 const ranged=['spider','bat','wraith','boss'].includes(e.type);
 const speed=e.speed*(e.slow>0?.48:1)*(e.type==='boss'&&e.hp<e.maxHp*.45?1.35:1);
 if(d<600){
   if(d>(ranged?235:e.r+hero.r+20)){e.x+=Math.cos(a)*speed*dt;e.y+=Math.sin(a)*speed*dt}
   else if(ranged&&d<155){e.x-=Math.cos(a)*speed*.35*dt;e.y-=Math.sin(a)*speed*.35*dt}
   if(e.attackAt<=0){
     if(ranged&&d<520){
       e.attackAt=e.type==='boss'?(e.hp<e.maxHp*.5?1.25:1.85):rand(1.5,2.6);
       const rounds=e.type==='boss'?(e.hp<e.maxHp*.45?5:3):1;
       swStartMonsterCast(e,a,true,rounds);
     }else if(d<e.r+hero.r+35){
       e.attackAt=e.type==='boss'?.75:rand(1,1.6);
       swStartMonsterCast(e,a,false,1);
     }
   }
 }
 e.x=clamp(e.x,60,GW-60);e.y=clamp(e.y,60,GH-60);
}
function update(dt){clock+=dt;worldTick+=dt;uiTimer+=dt;saveTimer+=dt;s.playtime+=dt;hero.slash=Math.max(0,hero.slash-dt);hero.invuln=Math.max(0,hero.invuln-dt);hero.shield=Math.max(0,hero.shield-dt);s.mp=Math.min(s.maxMp,s.mp+dt*2.8);
 let dx=0,dy=0;if(keys.has('w')||keys.has('arrowup')||pad.has('up'))dy--;if(keys.has('s')||keys.has('arrowdown')||pad.has('down'))dy++;if(keys.has('a')||keys.has('arrowleft')||pad.has('left'))dx--;if(keys.has('d')||keys.has('arrowright')||pad.has('right'))dx++;
 const hasInput=!!(dx||dy),speed=250*(s.cls==='ranger'?1.20:1);if(hasInput){updateHeroFacing(dx,dy);const len=Math.hypot(dx,dy);dx/=len;dy/=len}
 const targetVx=hasInput?dx*speed:0,targetVy=hasInput?dy*speed:0;
 // 高響應的速度平滑：起步柔順、放手快速停止，同時保留即時操控感。
 const response=hasInput?30:38,blend=1-Math.exp(-response*dt);hero.vx+=(targetVx-hero.vx)*blend;hero.vy+=(targetVy-hero.vy)*blend;
 if(!hasInput&&Math.hypot(hero.vx,hero.vy)<2){hero.vx=0;hero.vy=0}
 const nx=clamp(hero.x+hero.vx*dt,43,GW-43),ny=clamp(hero.y+hero.vy*dt,55,GH-55);if(nx===43||nx===GW-43)hero.vx=0;if(ny===55||ny===GH-55)hero.vy=0;hero.x=nx;hero.y=ny;
 const motion=Math.hypot(hero.vx,hero.vy);hero.moving=motion>5;if(hero.moving)hero.walk+=dt*(7.8+3.2*Math.min(1,motion/speed));
 // 鏡頭使用幀率無關的柔和追蹤，降低手機上因幀時間波動造成的頓挫。
 const camX=clamp(hero.x-VW/2,0,GW-VW),camY=clamp(hero.y-VH/2,0,GH-VH),camBlend=1-Math.exp(-18*dt);camera.x+=(camX-camera.x)*camBlend;camera.y+=(camY-camera.y)*camBlend;
 if(areaInfo().safe)updateAmbientNPCs(dt);
 if(!areaInfo().safe){spawnTimer-=dt;if(spawnTimer<=0){spawnWave();spawnTimer=8.5}for(const e of enemies)monsterAI(e,dt)}
 for(let i=projs.length-1;i>=0;i--){let p=projs[i];p.x+=p.vx*dt;p.y+=p.vy*dt;p.life-=dt;if(p.friendly){for(const e of enemies){if(e.dead||p.hitIds.has(e))continue;if(Math.hypot(p.x-e.x,p.y-e.y)<p.r+e.r){p.hitIds.add(e);hurtEnemy(e,p.dmg,16);p.piercing--;if(p.piercing<=0){p.life=0;break}}}}else if(Math.hypot(p.x-hero.x,p.y-hero.y)<p.r+hero.r){receiveDamage(p.dmg);if(p.swSkill)swSkillBurst(p.swSkill,p.x,p.y,p.swSkill==='boss'?85:63);p.life=0;emit(p.x,p.y,p.color,7,90)}if(p.life<=0||p.x<0||p.x>GW||p.y<0||p.y>GH)projs.splice(i,1)}
 swUpdateSkillBursts(dt);
 for(const n of nodes){if(n.respawn>0)n.respawn=Math.max(0,n.respawn-dt)}
 for(let i=parts.length-1;i>=0;i--){let p=parts[i];p.x+=p.vx*dt;p.y+=p.vy*dt;p.vx*=Math.max(0,1-dt*3);p.vy*=Math.max(0,1-dt*3);p.life-=dt;if(p.life<=0)parts.splice(i,1)}for(let i=floating.length-1;i>=0;i--){let x=floating[i];x.y-=dt*52;x.life-=dt;if(x.life<=0)floating.splice(i,1)}
 if(uiTimer>.3){uiTimer=0;updateHud();if(currentTab==='quest')renderSide();else if(currentTab==='hero'){const sig=[s.cls,s.level,s.weapon,s.armor,s.bountyDone].join(':');if(sig!==lastHeroSignature){lastHeroSignature=sig;renderSide()}}}if(saveTimer>12){saveTimer=0;save(true)}
}

function rebuildWorldCache(){

  const plaza=a==='town'&&x>200&&x<1420&&y>240&&y<730;
  const horizontal=Math.abs(y+24-457)<(safe?116:95);
  const vertical=safe?Math.abs(x+24-772)<90:a==='forest'?Math.abs(x+24-800)<55:a==='field'?Math.abs(x+24-800)<52:false;
   let tile=dark?(a==='ruins'?(hash<10?11:12):(hash<10?9:10)):a==='forest'?(hash<11?5:6):safe?(hash<9?0:1):(hash<9?0:2);
   const decor=(Math.abs(ix*31+iy*17+ORDER.indexOf(a)*11))%41;
   if(!horizontal&&!vertical&&!plaza){
     if(a==='forest'&&decor<12)tile=[40,41,42,43,44][decor%5];
     else if(a==='field'&&decor<10)tile=[24,25,26,30,31][decor%5];
     else if(a==='town'&&decor<7)tile=[24,25,30][decor%3];
     else if(a==='moon'&&decor<11)tile=[27,48,49,25][decor%4];
     else if(a==='dusk'&&decor<10)tile=[40,42,43,44][decor%4];
     else if(a==='cave'&&decor<6)tile=[52,53,54][decor%3];
     else if(a==='ruins'&&decor<7)tile=[50,51][decor%2];
     else if(a==='forgecamp'&&decor<7)tile=[46,54,29][decor%3];
   }
   if(horizontal||vertical||plaza){tile=dark?(hash%3===0?22:7):safe?(hash%4===0?14:(hash%3===0?4:3)):(hash%3===0?13:3);
     if(a==='town'&&plaza&&decor===4)tile=47;

     if(a==='ruins'&&decor===6)tile=50;
   }
   tileAt(c,tile,x,y);
 }
 drawCachedScenery(c);worldCacheKey=a;
}

function drawNode(n){if(n.used||n.respawn>0)return;const types={herb:'herb',charm:'star',leaf:'leaf',flower:'flower',crystal:'crystal',ore:'ore',page:'book',altar:'altar'};

 g.font='bold 13px system-ui';g.textAlign='center';g.fillStyle='#fff1cd';g.fillText(n.name,n.x,n.y-46);g.restore()}

     g.fillStyle=p.color;g.beginPath();g.arc(p.x,p.y,p.r,0,TWO);g.fill();

 }else{g.fillStyle=p.color;g.shadowColor=p.color;g.shadowBlur=22;g.beginPath();g.arc(p.x,p.y,p.r,0,TWO);g.fill()}

function loop(time){let dt=lastFrame?Math.min(.04,(time-lastFrame)/1000):.016;lastFrame=time;if(mode==='play')update(dt);else clock+=dt*.3;draw();requestAnimationFrame(loop)}
function perform(action){if(action==='attack')basicAttack();if(action==='q')skillQ();if(action==='e')skillE();if(action==='interact')interaction();if(action==='potion')potion();if(action==='quests'){switchTab('quest');$('sideBody').scrollTop=0}}

for(const b of document.querySelectorAll('[data-open]'))b.addEventListener('click',()=>switchTab(b.dataset.open));
for(const b of document.querySelectorAll('[data-dir]')){const d=b.dataset.dir;const down=ev=>{ev.preventDefault();pad.add(d);try{b.setPointerCapture(ev.pointerId)}catch{}};const up=ev=>{ev.preventDefault();pad.delete(d)};b.addEventListener('pointerdown',down);b.addEventListener('pointerup',up);b.addEventListener('pointercancel',up);b.addEventListener('lostpointercapture',up)}
for(const b of document.querySelectorAll('[data-action]')){b.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{e.preventDefault();perform(b.dataset.action)})}
for(const b of document.querySelectorAll('[data-tab]'))b.addEventListener('click',()=>switchTab(b.dataset.tab));

function nearestDoor(range=86){let best=null,bd=range;for(const d of DOORS[s.area]||[]){const px=clamp(hero.x,d.x-d.w/2,d.x+d.w/2),py=clamp(hero.y,d.y-d.h/2,d.y+d.h/2),dist=Math.hypot(hero.x-px,hero.y-py);if(dist<bd){bd=dist;best=d}}return best}
function drawDoor(d){g.save();g.fillStyle='#2a1d13';g.fillRect(d.x-d.w/2,d.y-d.h/2,d.w,d.h);g.strokeStyle='#d7bc82';g.lineWidth=3;g.strokeRect(d.x-d.w/2,d.y-d.h/2,d.w,d.h);g.fillStyle='#fcebc2';g.font='bold 13px system-ui';g.textAlign='center';g.fillText(d.name,d.x,d.y-d.h/2-10);g.restore()}
function useDoor(d){if(d)loadArea(d.to,d.spawn)}
function getSolids(area=s.area){return STATIC_SOLIDS[area]||[]}
function circleHitsRect(cx,cy,r,o){const qx=clamp(cx,o.x,o.x+o.w),qy=clamp(cy,o.y,o.y+o.h);return Math.hypot(cx-qx,cy-qy)<r}
function blockedAt(x,y,r=20,area=s.area){for(const o of getSolids(area)){if(circleHitsRect(x,y,r,o))return true}return false}
function resolveCircleMove(x,y,nx,ny,r=20,area=s.area){let rx=x,ry=y;if(!blockedAt(nx,y,r,area))rx=nx;if(!blockedAt(rx,ny,r,area))ry=ny;return {x:rx,y:ry}}
function buildAmbientNPCs(area){ambientNPCs=[];const count=AMBIENT_COUNTS[area]||0,routes=AMBIENT_ROUTES[area]||[];if(!count||!routes.length)return;const rng=seeded(78013+Math.max(0,ORDER.indexOf(area))*907);const actorPool=['traveler','guide','merchant','child','librarian','healer','guard','scout','wood','herbalist','cartographer','artificer','duskhead','moonmerchant'];for(let i=0;i<count;i++){const base=routes[i%routes.length],route=base.map(([x,y])=>({x:x+(rng()-.5)*22,y:y+(rng()-.5)*18}));const start=Math.floor(rng()*route.length),p=route[start];ambientNPCs.push({ambient:true,name:AMBIENT_NAMES[i%AMBIENT_NAMES.length],line:AMBIENT_LINES[i%AMBIENT_LINES.length],x:p.x,y:p.y,route,target:(start+1)%route.length,speed:48+rng()*26,wait:rng()*1.2,dir:i%2?2:0,step:rng()*2,chat:0,actor:actorPool[i%actorPool.length],r:18})}}
function updateAmbientNPCs(dt){for(const n of ambientNPCs){n.chat=Math.max(0,n.chat-dt);if(n.wait>0){n.wait-=dt;continue}const p=n.route[n.target],dx=p.x-n.x,dy=p.y-n.y,d=Math.hypot(dx,dy);if(d<8){n.x=p.x;n.y=p.y;n.target=(n.target+1)%n.route.length;n.wait=.3+Math.random()*.7;continue}const vx=dx/d,vy=dy/d;if(Math.abs(vx)>Math.abs(vy))n.dir=vx<0?1:2;else n.dir=vy<0?3:0;const nearHero=Math.hypot(n.x-hero.x,n.y-hero.y)<42;if(nearHero){n.wait=.25;continue}const move=Math.min(d,n.speed*dt),prevX=n.x,prevY=n.y,pos=resolveCircleMove(n.x,n.y,n.x+vx*move,n.y+vy*move,18,s.area);n.x=pos.x;n.y=pos.y;if(Math.hypot(n.x-prevX,n.y-prevY)<.25){n.wait=.25;n.target=(n.target+1)%n.route.length;continue}n.step+=dt*7}}

 }
 if(area==='camp')for(const [x,y] of [[354,300],[670,727],[1160,740]])out.push({x:x-58,y:y-45,w:116,h:54});

 // deterministic random scenery drawn in drawCachedScenery
 const dark=['cave','ruins'].includes(area),idx=Math.max(0,ORDER.indexOf(area)),rand=seeded(41452+idx*11122);let count=area==='town'?26:dark?58:area==='forest'?100:62;
 for(let i=0;i<count;i++){

   if(area==='forest'||area==='field')out.push({x:x-22,y:y-30,w:44,h:38});

function actorPoolV5(area){const pool=ART_DATA.actorKeys.filter(k=>!['novice','knight','mage','ranger','board','campboard','duskboard','moonboard','forgeboard'].includes(k));const off=Math.max(0,ORDER.indexOf(area))*5;return pool.map((_,i)=>pool[(i+off)%pool.length])}
function npcPositionFreeV5(n,x,y){
if(x<55||x>GW-55||y<70||y>GH-60||blockedAt(x,y,18,s.area))return false;
 for(const p of GATES[s.area]||[])if(Math.hypot(x-p.x,y-p.y)<105)return false;
 for(const d of DOORS[s.area]||[])if(Math.hypot(x-d.x,y-d.y)<90)return false;
 for(const f of NPCS[s.area]||[])if(Math.hypot(x-f.x,y-f.y)<68)return false;
 for(const o of ambientNPCs)if(o!==n&&Math.hypot(x-o.x,y-o.y)<42)return false;
 return true;
}
function chooseAmbientTargetV5(n,rng=Math.random){const z=n.zone;for(let t=0;t<28;t++){const x=z.x1+rng()*(z.x2-z.x1),y=z.y1+rng()*(z.y2-z.y1);if(npcPositionFreeV5(n,x,y)){n.tx=x;n.ty=y;return true}}n.tx=n.x;n.ty=n.y;return false}
buildAmbientNPCs=function(area){ambientNPCs=[];const count=AMBIENT_COUNTS[area]||0,zones=AMBIENT_ZONES_V5[area]||[];if(!count||!zones.length)return;const rng=seeded(92021+Math.max(0,ORDER.indexOf(area))*1319),pool=actorPoolV5(area);for(let i=0;i<count;i++){const z=zones[i%zones.length];let n={ambient:true,name:AMBIENT_NAMES[(i+Math.max(0,ORDER.indexOf(area))*3)%AMBIENT_NAMES.length],line:AMBIENT_LINES[i%AMBIENT_LINES.length],x:(z.x1+z.x2)/2,y:(z.y1+z.y2)/2,zone:z,tx:0,ty:0,speed:43+rng()*20,wait:rng()*.9,dir:i%2?2:0,step:rng()*2,chat:0,actor:pool[i%pool.length],r:18};for(let k=0;k<30;k++){const x=z.x1+rng()*(z.x2-z.x1),y=z.y1+rng()*(z.y2-z.y1);if(npcPositionFreeV5(n,x,y)){n.x=x;n.y=y;break}}ambientNPCs.push(n);chooseAmbientTargetV5(n,rng)}};
updateAmbientNPCs=function(dt){for(const n of ambientNPCs){n.chat=Math.max(0,n.chat-dt);if(n.wait>0){n.wait-=dt;continue}let dx=n.tx-n.x,dy=n.ty-n.y,d=Math.hypot(dx,dy);if(d<8){n.wait=.35+Math.random()*.8;chooseAmbientTargetV5(n);continue}const vx=dx/d,vy=dy/d;if(Math.abs(vx)>Math.abs(vy))n.dir=vx<0?1:2;else n.dir=vy<0?3:0;if(Math.hypot(n.x-hero.x,n.y-hero.y)<44){n.wait=.25;continue}const move=Math.min(d,n.speed*dt),nx=n.x+vx*move,ny=n.y+vy*move;if(!npcPositionFreeV5(n,nx,ny)){n.wait=.2+Math.random()*.35;chooseAmbientTargetV5(n);continue}const pos=resolveCircleMove(n.x,n.y,nx,ny,18,s.area);if(Math.hypot(pos.x-n.x,pos.y-n.y)<.25){n.wait=.25;chooseAmbientTargetV5(n);continue}n.x=pos.x;n.y=pos.y;n.step+=dt*6.8}};

// --- Precise interactions: nearest valid target wins. ---
function interactiveTargetV5(){const a=[];for(const n of NPCS[s.area]||[]){const d=distance(hero,n);if(d<108)a.push({kind:'npc',o:n,d})}for(const n of ambientNPCs){const d=distance(hero,n);if(d<82)a.push({kind:'ambient',o:n,d})}const f=nearestFurniture(78);if(f)a.push({kind:'furniture',o:f,d:Math.hypot(hero.x-f.x,hero.y-f.y)});const door=nearestDoor(82);if(door)a.push({kind:'door',o:door,d:Math.hypot(hero.x-door.x,hero.y-door.y)});for(const p of GATES[s.area]||[]){const d=distance(hero,p);if(d<108)a.push({kind:'gate',o:p,d})}for(const n of nodes.filter(x=>!x.used&&x.respawn<=0)){const d=distance(hero,n);if(d<86)a.push({kind:'node',o:n,d})}a.sort((x,y)=>x.d-y.d);return a[0]||null}
interaction=function(){if(mode!=='play')return;const t=interactiveTargetV5();if(!t)return toast('附近沒有可互動的物件');if(t.kind==='npc')return talk(t.o);if(t.kind==='ambient'){t.o.chat=2.7;t.o.wait=Math.max(t.o.wait,2.2);return toast('💬 '+t.o.name+'：'+t.o.line)}if(t.kind==='furniture')return interactFurniture(t.o);if(t.kind==='door')return useDoor(t.o);if(t.kind==='gate')return changeArea(t.o.to);if(t.kind==='node')return gather(t.o)};

// --- Terrain-aware monsters. Flying / incorporeal types are explicitly allowed to phase through terrain. ---
const PHASING_MONSTERS_V5=new Set(['bat','wraith']);
function monsterMoveV5(e,nx,ny){if(PHASING_MONSTERS_V5.has(e.type))return{x:clamp(nx,60,GW-60),y:clamp(ny,60,GH-60)};return resolveCircleMove(e.x,e.y,clamp(nx,60,GW-60),clamp(ny,60,GH-60),Math.max(16,e.r*.72),s.area)}
monsterAI=function(e,dt){
 if(e.dead)return;
 e.phase+=dt;e.hit=Math.max(0,e.hit-dt);e.attackAt-=dt;
 e.swMoving=false;
 e.stun=Math.max(0,e.stun-dt);e.slow=Math.max(0,e.slow-dt);
 if(e.stun>0)return;
 if(e.swCast){
   e.swCast.remaining-=dt;
   if(e.swCast.remaining<=0){const cast=e.swCast;e.swCast=null;swReleaseMonsterCast(e,cast)}
   return;
 }
 const d=distance(e,hero),a=Math.atan2(hero.y-e.y,hero.x-e.x);
 const ranged=['spider','bat','wraith','boss'].includes(e.type);
 const speed=e.speed*(e.slow>0?.48:1)*(e.type==='boss'&&e.hp<e.maxHp*.45?1.35:1);
 let mx=0,my=0;
 if(d<600){
   if(d>(ranged?235:e.r+hero.r+20)){mx=Math.cos(a)*speed*dt;my=Math.sin(a)*speed*dt}
   else if(ranged&&d<155){mx=-Math.cos(a)*speed*.35*dt;my=-Math.sin(a)*speed*.35*dt}
   if(mx||my){
     let p=monsterMoveV5(e,e.x+mx,e.y+my);
     if(p.x===e.x&&p.y===e.y&&!PHASING_MONSTERS_V5.has(e.type)){
       const side=Math.sin(e.phase*1.7)>0?1:-1;
       p=monsterMoveV5(e,e.x-Math.sin(a)*speed*.55*dt*side,e.y+Math.cos(a)*speed*.55*dt*side);
     }
     const ox=e.x,oy=e.y;e.x=p.x;e.y=p.y;
     const traveled=Math.hypot(e.x-ox,e.y-oy);
     if(traveled>.035){e.swMoving=true;e.swWalk=(e.swWalk||0)+traveled;
       if(Math.abs(e.x-ox)>.12)e.swFace=e.x>ox?1:-1;
     }
   }
   if(e.attackAt<=0){
     if(ranged&&d<520){
       e.attackAt=e.type==='boss'?(e.hp<e.maxHp*.5?1.25:1.85):rand(1.5,2.6);
       swStartMonsterCast(e,a,true,e.type==='boss'?(e.hp<e.maxHp*.45?5:3):1);
     }else if(d<e.r+hero.r+35){
       e.attackAt=e.type==='boss'?.75:rand(1,1.6);
       swStartMonsterCast(e,a,false,1);
     }
   }
 }
};
